name: MinerMetricCard
description: Single-metric card (hashrate, temperature, or power) for one miner with sparkline and delta
descriptionFull:
Single-metric card (hashrate, temperature, or power) for one miner with sparkline and delta.

Displays key metrics for a miner including: - Efficiency (fixed position top-right) - Hash rate, Temperature - Frequency, Consumption - Optional secondary stats in grid

props.name: primaryStats
props.description: Primary statistics (efficiency, hashrate, temperature, frequency, consumption)

props.name: secondaryStats
props.description: Secondary statistics to display in grid

props.name: showSecondaryStats
props.description: Whether to show secondary stats section

fields.name: name
fields.description: In `primaryStats`, selects the slot and must be exactly 'Efficiency', 'Hash rate', 'Temperature', 'Frequency' or 'Consu…
fields.descriptionFull: In `primaryStats`, selects the slot and must be exactly 'Efficiency', 'Hash rate', 'Temperature', 'Frequency' or 'Consumption'; in `secondaryStats`, the label (and React key)

fields.name: value
fields.description: Displayed value; Efficiency only shows when it is a number

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit appended after the value in `primaryStats`; ignored in `secondaryStats`, so fold it into `value` there
